tool_args.rationale: The pilot spans only H = 0.16–0.48, far below the target horizon. A slow-horizon probe is needed to identify the adaptation timescale and distinguish long-horizon behavior.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow adaptation reliably at the target horizon of 21.8.
A finer short trajectory is less directly informative about long-horizon adaptation.
It is irrelevant to the identified long-horizon ambiguity.
The short pilot does not distinguish these from sink-coupled adaptation; the long-horizon probe can provide discriminating evidence.
